summary: KB Financial Group filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of a foreign private issuer current report) disclosing that its board resolved on October 2, 2026 to convene an extraordinary general meeting on November 20, 2026 in Seoul. The sole agenda item is appointment of an executive director: nominee Jae Keun Lee, born May 1966, for a three-year term, currently Chief Business Officer of Global, WM and SME. Record date is October 19, 2026; e-voting via the Korea Securities Depository is available. This is a routine board-appointment EGM notice, not a special situation.
